name: mor-nakisib
description: Nakišib (stone seal): Kišib's offline companion, for a Mac that never connects. The air-gapped chain-key signer Module given a face: Kišib's pending rotation read and summarised from its exact bytes, the paper typed, a fresh paper drawn and three parts asked back, signed on SIGN; a new identity's first paper and its commitment. Keeps nothing secret. No network. Never a web client. Test identities only, until MOR is frozen.
